items.title: Musk Says SpaceX Will Hit a Revenue Number That Not One of Its 37 Analysts Believes
items.summary: Elon Musk calls his latest SpaceX forecast a best guess, not a promise, yet it dwarfs every model on the Street. The gap between his vision and the current quarterly numbers shows just how much has to go right.

items.title: Walmart Backs Zipline With 300 More Drone Sites as $1.5B Raise Closes
items.summary: The 300-site expansion builds on Walmart's 2 million drone deliveries to date, with Zipline using its new capital to expand U.S. manufacturing and hiring.

items.title: Alphabet’s Drone Unit to Invest Up to $125 Million in New Texas Facility

items.title: Rate Hikes Could Be Coming: History Likes These 4 Consumer Staples Stocks
